errata.was: AI-assisted (substrate). Written under the heteronyms Nobel Glas and Orin Trace (legal author Lee Sharks). The investigation was run by Lee Sharks with two machine collaborators on the same public data: Claude (Anthropic), which ran the Green Bank, Parkes and MeerKAT searches and the frozen runs and composed the notebook in session on 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06; and ChatGPT (OpenAI), whose ATA searches, audits of the thirteen and C03 reports Lee supplied and are filed as written (chatgpt/). Each system's results were checked by the other through code and tables. The questions, the rulings on the Overview and on Loeb, the authorship and venue, and the decision to deposit are Lee Sharks's, quoted verbatim in §12. The revisions on three outside reviews (DeepSeek once, ChatGPT twice) are recorded in §13.
